target.description: the same large private multi-tenant SaaS backend as b01 and b03

method.authored: each target carries must_include / acceptable sets written by hand from the b03 gold and an independent scan; no TraceLink output was used to build them
method.evidence_check: a finding counts as supported at a target only when the anchor that brought it there is written as code by the AUTHOR — the managed block is cut out first, or the tool would certify its own evidence

A_wrong_evidence.cause: a bare word in the prose that also names an indexed symbol

B_irrelevant_context.cause: one of them names a path in order to DENY a relationship, and is anchored to it anyway — negation is not read, by design

C_bad_ordering.note: on the busiest target all nine findings were useful and in anchor order; no data supports a ranking or budget change yet

discipline: resolver frozen for this benchmark; two flaws found in the SCORER were fixed and are described, not hidden
